Overview & availability

48 features
›

Self

5
Link to this section ↗

Local player

Self tools

Health, core, stamina, wanted and visibility controls are grouped under Self. Gameplay behavior depends on the supported build and local player.

Movement

Movement options include super run, super jump and swimming controls.

Walking Noclip

Move through obstacles on foot with camera-relative left-stick input while retaining aim and fire.

  • Speed settings
  • Movement pauses while the menu is open
Walking styles

Choose a walking-style preset or reset the current style.

Animations & scenarios

Browse animation, emote and scenario pages, with search and stop controls.

›

Appearance

4
Link to this section ↗

Wardrobe

Appearance pages

Browse model, outfit and component categories. Model changes remain under gameplay validation.

Outfit editor

Choose clothing components and their available variations for the current model.

Saved outfits

Save and load outfit files through the PS4 menu. Compatible legacy outfit files are listed separately.

Outfit presets

Browse gender-specific outfit presets. Individual presets and model compatibility remain in testing.

›

Weapons

7
Link to this section ↗

Loadout & weapon visuals

Loadout

Weapon selection and give/equip controls are organized in a dedicated loadout page.

Ammo

Ammo options have their own page, separate from loadout and visuals.

Weapon options

Browse weapon, clip, damage and maintenance controls for the current local player.

Weapon visuals

Laser sight, bullet tracer and throwable tracer settings are grouped under Visuals. Individual rendering behavior is still being refined.

Crosshair

Configure the crosshair independently from the ESP and weapon settings.

Aim & Silent Aim

Targeting, activation and key-binding controls are present. Recent fixes await live acceptance; reliable targeting is not established.

Weapon effects

Explosion Gun, Entity Shooter, Gravity Gun and Bullet Swap controls. Recent callback, launch and projectile changes require live testing.

›

Esp

5
Link to this section ↗

Separate category settings

Player ESP

Configure player labels, boxes, lines, health and distance. Skeleton and other detailed visuals remain under validation.

NPC & animal ESP

NPCs and horses have separate visual settings, including labels and distance.

Vehicle ESP

Vehicle visuals focus on box, line, name and distance controls.

Self ESP

Configure local-player visuals independently of other players.

Visual style

Adjust colors, text scale, label placement and backgrounds per category.

›

Players

4
Link to this section ↗

Player list

Players list

Browse current session players from Network → Players.

Player tags

Labels can identify the local player, host and friends when that information is available.

Player info

Choose whether the selected-player information panel is shown. Portraits, IP addresses and geolocation are not available in this PS4 build.

Selected & All Players actions

Player action pages include cages and remote controls. Cages were observed in earlier test builds; newer remote effects and this exact beta remain under validation.

›

Teleport

5
Link to this section ↗

Locations & travel

Waypoint teleport

Travel to the current map waypoint when a valid destination can be resolved.

Objective teleport

Use the current supported objective destination.

Automatic waypoint & objective travel

Automatic travel has its own toggles; the matching one-shot buttons are hidden while auto mode is enabled.

Saved locations

Save, browse and load your own named destinations.

Destination categories

Browse organized destination lists and closest-location controls. Live camp and Madam Nazar routing depend on additional verified game state.

›

World & spawner

7
Link to this section ↗

World and entity pages

World controls

Weather, time and world settings are organized into their own pages.

Spawner categories

Browse pedestrian, animal, horse, vehicle, object and plant pages. Availability depends on the model and current game state.

Spawn settings

Each supported entity category has its own placement and management options.

Spawned entity management

Manage tracked spawned entities. Treasure lifetime and visibility to other players remain under testing; full synchronization is not promised.

Bodyguard Manager

Recruit, manage and equip a tracked squad, issue orders and save squad presets. Availability depends on game state and model support.

Pet Manager

Spawn or adopt dogs, manage Follow/Stay orders and save pet presets. Console acceptance and complete Story/Online coverage remain pending.

Treasure & entity management

Treasure chest and entity controls are present. Spawn visibility, persistence and reward availability vary and remain under testing.

›

Recovery

4
Link to this section ↗

Current request controls

Money & Gold requests

Individual requests, loop toggles, batch size and local delay controls. Game eligibility and reward processing determine payouts; a locally accepted request does not confirm a reward.

Inventory collection sets

Inventory collection sets, plus guarded Fossil and Bird Egg Loot requests, are grouped under Recovery → XP. Completion status does not establish inventory or XP gains; eligibility and session state can reject requests.

Recovery status & stop

Inspect recovery activity, per-reward request/receipt status and available character XP/rank readback, or stop pending work. A receipt is separate from an observed XP change; role totals are not sampled.

Character & Role XP requests

Individual and combined XP request controls with loop delays. Batches continue after definitive rejection of an independent track; pending or unknown requests retain their guards. The 25k menu label is not a guaranteed XP quantity.

›

Settings

7
Link to this section ↗

Interface & controls

Controller navigation

R1 + Square opens or closes the menu. D-pad navigation, X select, Circle back and Square search.

PS4 keyboard

Use controller text entry for search, numeric values and supported file-name fields.

Themes & colors

Choose menu themes and customize interface colors.

Layout

Adjust menu position, scale, section visibility and descriptions.

Backgrounds

Configure supported header/background images and animation settings.

Configuration profiles

Save and load game-specific settings profiles.

Overlays

Configure watermark, FPS, session/pool information and open-menu hints where supported.
